result_text:
I changed `all_files.zip` to take its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks the export. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or a report export, so the renamed-aspect case itself is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the block that builds `all_files.zip`. It used to read five fixed file names such as `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. When an aspect was renamed, that file didn't exist, the read threw, and the surrounding catch swallowed it. That also skipped `git-history.zip`, which is written after it in the same block.

It now loops over the five scope aspects in the same order (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other). For each one it gets the name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose `data/text` files. It reads that file and uses the same name for the zip entry.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written when `git-history.txt` exists.
